critical_code_review_comments: adapter.cancelOrder default exchange_code='NSE' — order-actions.service.ts passes position.exchange ?? 'NSE' which is correct, but manual-trade flow does not call cancel; low risk overall.
buildIciciOrder sends quantity/price/stoploss as strings and empty-string sentinels for unused fields — matches Breeze SDK conventions.

iciciProduct maps NRML→'futures'. Breeze also supports 'options'/'eatm'/'btst' etc; if the admin ever places an options manual trade with product NRML, the payload will be 'futures'. Acceptable for equity/F&O MVP but worth documenting.
mapIciciProduct in order-actions.service.ts accepts CNC/CASH/DELIVERY/MIS/MARGIN/INTRADAY/NRML/FUTURES — good tolerance. Consider adding 'OPTIONS' alias if options exit becomes a use case.
removeDuplicateMappings keeps the earliest createdAt row. If two rows share the exact same createdAt (unlikely but possible), the DELETE self-join with '>' will keep both. Consider tie-breaker on id.
Integrity fix endpoint is idempotent — safe to call repeatedly; report() re-runs after every fix().

success_rate.backend: 100% (static + boot-graph verification within stated env constraints)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Live end-to-end validation (placing a real Breeze order and receiving order_id) is inherently user-local — it needs the user's daily fresh Breeze SessionToken + real api key/secret + a running Postgres+Redis, none of which exist in this pod. Everything that CAN be verified statically (adapter REST calls, DTO mapping, DI graph, route registration) is verified and correct. The user should self-validate by logging into ICICI Direct daily and placing a small test manual order via /dashboard/manual-trading against an ICICI_DIRECT master account.
rca of the issue: Original bug: ManualTradeService.placeOnMaster only had ZERODHA and FYERS branches; ICICI_DIRECT fell through to the 'not supported for manual trade placement' BadRequestException. Additionally the ICICIDirectAdapter had placeOrder/modifyOrder/cancelOrder as {} stubs (no real Breeze REST call). Fix: added a full ICICI branch (buildIciciOrder + credentialed adapter + extractIciciOrderId) and implemented adapter.request(POST/PUT/DELETE) targeting Breeze 'order' endpoint with checksum headers; mirrored the change in OrderActionsService (modify/cancel/exit) and added ICICI_DIRECT to ACTIONABLE_BROKERS on both server (order-action-rules.ts) and client (orders/[key]/page.tsx). Broker dropdowns now source from shared ACTIVE_BROKERS registry instead of hardcoding ZERODHA/FYERS. Integrity service+controller+UI added end-to-end.
